notes.title: Welcome Twitch Viewers!
notes.content: Welcome to one and all! Thank for coming to check our our first game release, Robo Runners. We have worked hard to come out with something fun and casual to play with your friends. If you are joining us from DrLupo's Twitch Stream, you can queue up against him tonight at 7:30 CST. He will be streaming  Robo Runners now and possibly in the future. Have a look at the game for yourself and enjoy.
